label: sec:mass-predictions-derivations-preamble
html: This sub-section details specific mass derivations. We cover nucleon Borromean topology and the pair-skein mass formula. We analyze the flavor-split substrate and dressed-quark numerology at q_0. We derive the deuteron binding energy. The terminal-resolution closure anchors the categorical chain to the Archimedean evaluation. Finally, we examine the W-boson mass discrepancy, which remains a key open target.
